title: APS project instance
description: One project in the agent-project-schema tree: instruction, env, build, state and per-harness adapters. A checkout (main or worktree) owns nothing; it receives a fork of these.

project.description: Key of the project. Conventionally the repository directory name.

instruction.description: Absolute or ~-relative path, on the host, of the project's private instruction file (Markdown). Adapters import it; they never copy its content.

env.description: Checkout-relative paths of gitignored files every checkout needs (.env, local settings). Forked from the main checkout into each worktree. Values stay on the host.

seed.description: Command run from the main checkout to seed the build cache of a new worktree. The literal {worktree} is replaced by the worktree path. Example: cargo shared-target --dest {worktree}/target

artifact.description: Checkout-relative path that exists once the cache is seeded, for aps-wt-check. Example: target

docs.description: URL of the hosted document (journal, design notes) for this project. Working state is never kept inside a checkout.

stub.description: Checkout-relative path of the one-line stub that imports the instruction. Must be gitignored by the project.

location.description: Value for the Claude Code setting worktree.location, e.g. .worktrees

stub.description: Placeholder. The writer is disabled until the Codex local-override format is confirmed.
